canonical_worker_check: All worker per-token canonical and BOS-only baselines agree exactly.

confirm.interpretation: Descriptive two-way decomposition of passage BPB gaps. Shared-passage effects versus consistent tokenizer offsets versus tokenizer×passage residuals; finite-text noise is included, not isolated causally.

screen.interpretation: Descriptive two-way decomposition of passage BPB gaps. Shared-passage effects versus consistent tokenizer offsets versus tokenizer×passage residuals; finite-text noise is included, not isolated causally.

confirm.limitation: Selects a different tokenizer after seeing every passage loss. Optimistic finite-panel diagnostic, not a deployable policy or held-out generalization result.

screen.limitation: Selects a different tokenizer after seeing every passage loss. Optimistic finite-panel diagnostic, not a deployable policy or held-out generalization result.

limits: Stratified tokenizer subset is not a uniform sample of all1000
Five-domain balanced panel is not a prevalence estimate over arbitrary internet text
Two fresh disjoint document cohorts, excluded all source IDs used in the prior all-pool sweep
No new training or causal claim that RL beats uniform; fixed RL20k model only
Tail picked anew in each split is descriptive, not evidence the same passage replicates
Canonical-only context-benefit strata are diagnostic and are not the original training distribution

protocol_audit.interpretation: Initial character cuts often create a nonstandard canonical sequence at the seam. This post-hoc audit motivated the v2 boundary correction on the same documents. Targets change slightly with the cuts; compare transfer versus canonical within each version, not as a model-training improvement.
